title: Omnis caro ad te veniet.
html_source:
One of the many classical music references within this chapter alone, this line refers to Verdi’s Requiem, and means “all flesh must come” connecting with the imagery of the sun being “called”. Additionally, requiems are usually played at funerals, connecting with the “death” of the sun and the day, and the coming of the night.
